title: Patio
tagline: A place to relax enjoy and engage with virtual garden. Lens protocol (https://lens.dev/) browser.
description: A place to share your thoughts, support great content and engage with awesome people. Built on top of lens protocol - a new social media protocol. You own the profile and data here and there is no censorship. You can also choose to monetise the content as you see fit. The targeted audience are coming from web2 social media platforms hence the familiarity and simplified user experience.
how_its_made: I went through Lens api and integrated it with Next.js and DaisyUI for quick prototype. Have integrated a bunch of apis like session management, creating profile, post, mirror and collecting posts. Reading apis like timeline feed and user feed are also working, although facing some issue with apollo graphql caching.
